outcome: Cardiac geometry (left ventricular end diastolic diameter, intraventricular septal thickness, posterior wall diameter, relative wall thickness, left ventricular mass)
Diastolic indices (E/A ratio, tissue Doppler imaging E' lateral and medial, left atrial volume)
Longitudinal function (mitral plane annular systolic excursion)
cohort: Pregnant women, with either a booking body mass index (BMI) >=30 kg/m2 (n=59) or a normal booking BMI 20-24.9 kg/m2 (n=14).
finding: Maternal obesity is associated with hyperdynamic circulation, altered cardiac geometry, and suboptimal diastolic function during pregnancy, which may contribute to increased risk of complications.
gest_age: Observations were taken at 12-14, 20-24, and 30-32 weeks gestation.
